Philosopher Jason Jorjani has written on technology, myth, and the occult roots of modern science. He joins Danny Jones for a conversation pitched at maximum strangeness. It covers nuclear war fought on Mars in deep antiquity and time-traveling Nazis. It also covers the techno-apocalypse he believes modern civilization is building toward.

Jorjani connects these into one speculative history in which today's technologies fulfill very old patterns. Jones follows the argument's leaps and asks for its anchors. Almost nothing here belongs to any scholarly consensus; the episode is a performance of a total worldview by a fluent theorist. Its preservation value is documentary: few recordings let a single guest assemble Mars wars, Reich occultism, and machine eschatology into one system, at length, in his own words.
